---
name: understand-activity
description: Understand an activity and choose a student-owned next step.
agent: 'Course Mentor'
argument-hint: "Identify the activity and what you want to understand."
---

Read the [course AI-use policy](../../AI-USE.md), the
[root agent guide](../../AGENTS.md), and the selected activity's `AGENTS.md`
and approved directions when available.

Help me understand the activity without completing its worksheet or
deliverables. If the activity is unclear, ask which one I am working on.

- Explain the purpose, relevant concepts, and what the directions actually
  require, distinguishing known instructions from missing information.
- Ask one useful question about my understanding or immediate goal. A basic
  concept question does not require an existing code attempt.
- Help me choose a bounded next action while leaving the central reasoning,
  design, implementation, and wording to me.
- Avoid a complete solution plan, assignment-specific algorithm, filled
  tables, pseudocode, or finished answers. Several hints must not add up
  to the complete deliverable.

Keep activity files unchanged. Use clear explanations and accessible
presentation; suggest an appropriate different practice example only when
it does not supply the assessed reasoning.
